text: The next morning was bright and sunny. <break time="0.8s" /> And the paw on the sideboard. <break time="0.8s" /> Now looked harmless and a little silly. <break time="0.8s" /> Herbert laughed at his parents once more. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he left for the factory. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he worked every day. <break time="0.8s" /> That afternoon. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus White noticed a well dressed stranger. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was walking back and forth. <break time="0.8s" /> Outside the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> Finally he came in looking nervous. <break time="0.8s" /> And said that he had been sent by Maw and Meggins. <break time="0.8s" /> Herberts company. <break time="0.8s" /> Has something happened to Herbert. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus White asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Her voice shaking with fear. <break time="0.8s" /> The visitor said quietly that Herbert had been caught in the machines. <break time="0.8s" /> And the old couple understood. <break time="0.8s" /> That their son was dead. <break time="0.8s" /> The old man took his wifes hand. <break time="0.8s" /> And held it tightly. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as he had done. <break time="0.8s" /> Forty years before. <break time="0.8s" /> The company said that it was not responsible. <break time="0.8s" /> But it wished to give them some money. <break time="0.8s" /> For their loss. <break time="0.8s" /> How much. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked Mister White in a dry voice. <break time="0.8s" /> And the visitor answered. <break time="0.8s" /> Two hundred pounds. <break time="0.8s" /> Hearing those words. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus White screamed. <break time="0.8s" /> And Mister White fainted. <break time="0.8s" /> And fell to the floor.
